sections.title: Your sheet vs the app
sections.intro: Every line on the Bratt Pans, Mixes, Ovens and Sunday tabs, matched against what the app produces for the same run. 37 of the 65 comparable lines already agree and are not listed — these are the ones that do not. Meat Team and Sauces are absent because the workbook counts them in boxes and portions rather than kilos, and fish is excluded from Mixes and Ovens for the same reason.

sections.title: Recipe links to confirm
sections.intro: Each of these is an ingredient line that never connected to the recipe that makes it — the same fault as the Lentils one. Until it is linked, everything below it reads zero. Confirm whether the proposed recipe is the right one.

sections.title: Ingredients that point at themselves
sections.intro: The importer matched by name, so these recipes ended up listing themselves as their own ingredient. Ordering totals are already corrected in the app, but the data still needs cleaning. “Raw purchase” means it is bought in, not made here.

sections.title: Dishes with no components
sections.intro: These 14 dishes (61 meals) contribute nothing to any production requirement because nothing is defined underneath them. List the components and grams per portion, and the bill of materials can be built.

sections.title: Quantities that disagree
sections.intro: The app derives kilos from grams-per-dish; the workbook derives them from cooked-yield ratios. Where they differ, one of the two inputs is wrong.

sections.title: Decisions — James
sections.intro: These change how the app behaves rather than what the data says, so they need a call rather than a correction.

items.title: Raw vs cooked on the Sunday sheet
items.evidence: The Sunday tab is inconsistent: Black Lentils, Quinoa, Black Beans, Pearl Barley, Black Rice and Black Quinoa show RAW weight; Basmati and Wild Basmati show COOKED yield. The app shows cooked throughout, so Black Lentils reads 3.15 kg in the app against 1.22 kg on paper. Suggested: show both — “1.2 kg dry → 3.15 kg cooked”.

items.title: Simmer top-ups are not imported
items.evidence: The dish import takes the D2C column only, and matches exactly at 1,365 meals. The workbook's 1,377 includes 6 Simmer on SKU 6 (Chicken Black Dahl) and 6 on SKU 65 (Thai Super Green Chicken Curry). Should the importer add Simmer to the same SKU, or keep the wholesale lane separate?

items.title: Components with no recipe behind them
items.evidence: Chicken Thigh, Chicken chopped, Cubed Chicken and Meatballs have no recipe attached, so they show unlinked on Meat Team with nothing to click through to. They are butchery aggregates that only ever existed as lines on the MEAT TEAM tab. Write minimal prep specs, or leave them as plain quantity lines?

items.title: Biryani on the Sunday sheet
items.evidence: The workbook asks for 13.3 trays of Biryani Rice and 55.8 kg of Biryani on Bratt Pans, but SKU 74 is on All Dishes at quantity 0. James has confirmed this was added manually in error — no action needed in the app. Logged so it is not raised again.
